title: DevOps in 2025: Why Linux, Golang, and AIOps Are the Avengers of the Cloud World
summary: Kubernetes, GitOps, and ArgoCD are the new deployment superpowers — the trio redefining how teams ship, secure, and scale cloud-native applications in 2025

title: Week 1 — When LLM Failures Weren't About Load, But Timing (ZooKeeper + Distributed Locking)
summary: Investigating unexpected LLM failures caused by concurrent requests from multiple AWS clients. The fix involved using ZooKeeper for distributed locking to coordinate access to the model as a shared resource.

title: Week 2 — The AI Cold Start That Breaks Kubernetes Autoscaling
summary: Exploring why standard Kubernetes autoscaling breaks down for AI inference workloads, since AI models take significantly longer to initialize. Solutions like KEDA, model caching, and dedicated inference servers (Triton, KServe) are discussed.
